mode.tooltip:
Hide completely = notification never appears.
Show without sound = popup appears, no sound, same duration as system.
Without history = same + not saved in notification history.

blockedApps.tooltip: One name per line (or comma / semicolon separated). Matches exact names and substrings (case-insensitive).

logApps.tooltip: When enabled, every notification is written to the Cinnamon log (Looking Glass).

help-text.description:
How to find the exact app name:
1. Enable logging above
2. Press Alt+F2, type lg, press Enter
3. Open the Log tab
4. Trigger a notification from the unwanted app
5. Look for a line like:
   notification-filter@nort: notification from app 'AppName', summary 'Title'
6. Copy the app name or title into the list above
